title: Moving & Storage in Orange County | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Moving and storage in Orange County, booked as one job: our crew loads your home, stores everything climate-controlled and returns it on your date.
heroSubtitle: When the move-out and move-in dates refuse to line up, our crew collects your things, keeps them in a climate-controlled facility and brings them back on the day you pick.

faq.question: Do I need a pod or a rented unit for storage in Orange County?
faq.answer: No. Our crew loads your things at the door and takes them to our climate-controlled facility, so nothing stays on the driveway or at the curb. That also keeps you clear of city limits on street containers, such as the seven-day cap on a pod parked on a Huntington Beach street.

faq.question: How is moving and storage priced for an Orange County address?
faq.answer: Crew time for pickup and return follows the hourly rate card, and at this distance the drive beyond 10 miles is charged twice over, with the minimum raised to 4 hours once the job sits at least 30 miles away from our base. The storage term depends on unit size and availability, so we quote it after reviewing your inventory.

faq.question: Can you collect my things the same day I call?
faq.answer: Yes, when a crew is free that day. Pickups run Monday – Sunday between 8AM and 6PM, so an early call gives the best chance of loading the same afternoon.

faq.question: My remodel may run longer than planned. What happens to the storage term?
faq.answer: Tell us before the current term ends and we extend it without a penalty. For a project that still needs city review, as most exterior changes in Old Towne Orange do, long-term storage from a month up is the safer booking.

faq.question: Can you hold my belongings while I move from Orange County to another state?
faq.answer: Yes, that is in-transit storage: we keep the load at our facility until the new home is ready, then deliver it to the destination. The interstate leg is priced as a flat rate and runs under USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871.
